parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on the client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. This helps you identify the business purpose of the instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
